result.summary: Metrics: turnaround time = completion time - arrival time; waiting time = turnaround time - burst time; response time = first run time - arrival time. Round Robin (RR): each process gets a fixed time quantum and then goes to the back of the ready queue. Shortest Job First (SJF): runs the process with the smallest next CPU burst. result.summary: Slow start begins with a small congestion window (cwnd) and roughly doubles it every round trip until it reaches the slow-start threshold (ssthresh); then congestion avoidance increases cwnd by about one segment per round trip. Flow control uses the receiver's advertised window (rwnd) so the sender does not overwhelm the receiver's buffer. When a packet loss is detected by a timeout, TCP sets ssthresh to half of cwnd and restarts slow start. Congestion control protects the network.
